_note: Draft English rendering of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Bamidbar 28, generated by scripts/translate_tafsir_english.py against the JA (not the biblical Hebrew). Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: Then God spoke to Moses, speaking to him.
translations.2: Command the sons of Israel, and say to them: My offering — continual, pleasing, accepted — take care to bring it to Me in its appointed time.
translations.3: And make clear to them that the pleasing offering which you bring to God is two yearling male lambs without blemish — each day an offering, continually.
translations.4: One of them in the morning, and the other between the two settings.
translations.5: And a tenth of a waybah of fine wheat flour, mixed, with a quarter of a qist of pressed oil.
translations.6: A continual offering, as was done in the wilderness of Sinai — accepted and pleasing to God.
translations.7: And with it, from the mixed drink, a quarter of a qist for each lamb — to be poured in the sanctuary, a pouring from its aged kind, to God.
translations.8: And when you make the second lamb between the two settings, make it like the gift of the morning and its mixed drink as well — an offering accepted and pleasing to God.
translations.9: And on the Sabbath day: two yearling male lambs without blemish, and with them two tenths of fine wheat flour mixed with oil, and their mixed drink.
translations.10: That is the offering of Sabbath by Sabbath, together with the continual offering and its mixed drink.
translations.11: And at the heads of your months, bring an offering — a burnt-offering to God: two bulls from the cattle, and a ram, and seven yearling lambs without blemish.
translations.12: And three tenths of fine wheat flour mixed with oil for each bull, and two tenths for the ram.
translations.13: And a tenth of fine flour mixed with oil for each lamb likewise — an offering accepted and pleasing to God.
translations.14: And their mixed drink shall be: half a qist for each bull, and a third of a qist for the ram, and a quarter of a qist for the lamb — from the drink. This is the offering of month by month, for the months of the year.
translations.15: And a male goat-kid as a purification-offering to God — together with the continual offering, that shall be brought, with its mixed drink.
translations.16: And in the first month, on the fourteenth day of it — a Passover to God.
translations.17: And on the fifteenth day of it, a pilgrimage-festival: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.
translations.18: On the first day of it — a consecrated name; no work for gain shall you do.
translations.19: And bring an offering — a burnt-offering to God: two bulls from the cattle, and a ram, and seven yearling lambs; they shall be without blemish for you.
translations.20: And with them from the grain: fine flour mixed with oil — three tenths for each bull, and two tenths for the ram.
translations.21: And a tenth for each lamb from the seven.
translations.22: And a male goat-kid for the purification-offering, to seek forgiveness for you.
translations.23: Apart from the morning offering and the second continual offering — these you shall bring.
translations.24: And the like of it bring on each day of the seven days — an offering accepted and pleasing to God; together with the continual offering, that shall be brought, with its mixed drink.
translations.25: And on the seventh day — a consecrated name shall be for you; no work for gain shall you do.
translations.26: And on the day of first-fruits, when you bring a new grain-offering to God — after your weeks — a consecrated name shall be for you; no work for gain shall you do.
translations.27: And bring a burnt-offering, accepted and pleasing to God: two bulls from the cattle, and a ram, and seven yearling lambs.
translations.28: And with them from the grain: fine flour mixed with oil — three tenths for each bull, and two tenths for the ram.
translations.29: And a tenth for each lamb from the seven.
translations.30: And a male goat-kid from the goats, to seek forgiveness for you.
translations.31: Apart from the continual offering and its grain — these you shall bring; without blemish shall they be for you, and their mixed drink.
